messages:
Maria: Hey team — just pulled ACME Inc's March invoice and noticed the support band is still billed as 'Essential' even though legal signed an upgrade to 'Advanced' on 2026-02-10. totals don't match the contract.
Sam: Can you paste the invoice lines? we need invoice id and amounts to trace.
Maria: Invoice INV-2026-013, lines look like this from PDF extraction:
```
Platform fee (monthly) - Essential: $9,500
Support band - Essential: $2,000
VAT (20%) - $2,300
Total: $13,800
```
Contract signed Feb 10 should've pro-rated Advanced support (Advanced = $5,000/mo). expected charge for Mar should be pro-rated advanced + platform fee delta. invoice is wrong.
Elaine: Confirming: I have the signed amendment (signed 2026-02-10 by procurement@acme). Customer requested effective date 2026-02-15 for billing. I logged the change in CS portal but I might not have hit the billing checkbox. :grimacing: 
Sam: Ok — two issues: 1) support band not reclassified in billing system 2) tax looks like it's applied on wrong base (VAT looks like it included both pre-upgrade and post-upgrade). Need journal lines and AR reference to do a credit.
Trevor: For revenue ops: we'll need a manual credit for the difference plus a corrected invoice. How much is the credit if change is effective 2026-02-15? rough calc: pro-rate Advanced for remaining period and refund excess.
Maria: Quick calc I did: Feb prorate (16 days of Feb remaining) and full March at Advanced (customer billed full month). Rough credit = $3,000 (refund for Feb miscalc) + VAT on that amount = $600 -> $3,600 total credit. I put a note in the CS ticket: CS-8842.
BillingBot: Automated note: Invoice INV-2026-013 created 2026-03-01 10:12Z by invoice-service-v2. Line items derived from billing-config v1.7. No manual overrides present.
Sam: Trevor can you approve the manual credit? need GL code and if we can apply as credit memo vs refund.
Trevor: Approve credit memo for $3,600 and corrected invoice to replace INV-2026-013. GL: 4102 (Platform Revenue Adjustment) for net, 2109 for VAT. Please include reason code: SUPPORT_RECLASS_20260215.
Elaine: I'll confirm with the customer they accept a credit memo applied against next invoice. I'll update CS-8842 and add signed amendment attached. also will ask procurement to confirm VAT registration number (customer gave different VAT this year — might explain tax delta).
Maria: Thx. Sam, can you open an AR ticket and attach the corrected invoice PDF when ready? we need audit trail for renewals team.
Sam: On it. Creating AR-7629, tagging Trevor and Elaine. Will generate draft corrected invoice and notify once credit memo created.
Elaine: Also flagging product: can we add a billing-config guard so support band changes created in CS portal auto-set the billing checkbox? repeating manual misses are costly. @product pls consider.
Trevor: Good suggestion. For now, I'll ask revenue ops to add a checklist to the upgrade playbook.
Maria: Thanks all — summary: create credit memo $3,600 (GL codes above), issue corrected invoice, update CS ticket, confirm VAT number, and add playbook checklist. I'll follow up tomorrow after AR-7629 updates. :thumbsup:
